Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production SIXTEEN-frame transparent walking sprite atlas for a small web-app pet. The supplied image is the exact identity, color, anatomy and material reference. Preserve that character.
Layout: uniform 4-column by 4-row grid, square canvas, sixteen equal square cells. ONE full-body character in each cell, facing RIGHT in side / slight three-quarter view. Same body center, head, scale, camera, colors and proportions in every frame. All planted feet share the baseline at 91% cell height. Every ear, foot, hand, tail, crown or prop is fully inside its own cell with 8% padding.
The 16 distinct poses form ONE complete continuous in-place locomotion cycle, not multiple repeated short cycles. Frames 1–4 contact to support, 5–8 toe-off and swing, 9–12 opposite contact and support, 13–16 recover to loop into frame 1. All walking limbs must alternate front/back roles; no foot remains behind or drags. During stance the foot moves backwards relative to body; after toe-off it LIFTS clearly, bends, swings FORWARD beneath the body, then plants ahead. Keep head and torso stable, small weight shift only. No extra limbs, no ghost duplicates, no limb morphing.
Actual transparent RGBA alpha-zero empty background. No white matte, checkerboard, floor, cast shadow, scenery, grid, frame labels, text, watermark or color specks. Detailed clean antialiased artwork matching the reference, readable at 80–96 px.
Character and motion: Exact white and blue friendly robot dog, black face display with cyan 67, long black ear panels and small blue tail tip. Preserve FOUR articulated robotic legs. A smooth, deliberate robotic quadruped walk: near and far forelegs half a cycle apart, hind legs similarly alternate with a staggered canine walk phase. Clearly bend wrist and hock joints in swing; blue toe pads lift. Preserve shell, blue panels, proportions and the cyan 67 face display. Do not add wheels or change into a biped.

cheremsha.color:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: recolor an existing 16-frame transparent sprite atlas.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the 4 by 4 sixteen-frame hopping Cheremsha atlas. Image 2 is the PRIMARY CHARACTER APPEARANCE AND COLOR REFERENCE, the actual equipped pet in the app.
The user says the animation became much too dark. Restore the original pet's LIGHT WARM GOLDEN TAN fur, creamy ivory cheek ruff, pale chest and mane, warm amber eyes, softly defined brown markings and friendly broad face from image 2. The large pale ear interiors should remain warm peach/cream like image 2. The whole character must feel as light and warm as image 2, not dark brown or grey. Preserve detailed soft fluffy fur and gentle shading, no washed-out white silhouette.
Important identity: this is a compact fluffy HARE-LION hybrid, not a normal elongated lynx. Keep the long ears, lion-like muzzle, huge fluffy cream mane and compact rounded body. Four paws, rabbit-style hopping with both hind legs acting together.
PRESERVE EXACTLY the sixteen DIFFERENT existing hopping poses, all paw locations and four-legged anatomy, each cell's alignment and scale, camera, 4-column by 4-row equal grid, square canvas and original dimensions. Do not rearrange cells or invent a new gait. Keep the same complete hop from crouch to push-off, flight, forepaw landing, hindpaw recovery and settle. Do not replace this with sixteen sitting pets. Only correct the fur colors and brightness and restore the original reference's friendly face.
Transparent background must remain true RGBA alpha-zero outside the character, no matte, background, checkerboard, shadows, text or color specks. Keep clean soft fur edges.
